welcome.label: Welcome to Lac Hôtel
welcome.title: An exceptional eco-lodge facing Lake Sahambavy
welcome.subtitle: Charm & Comfort in the heart of nature and Madagascar's only tea plantation
welcome.intro: If paradise exists on earth, it is here… 5,000 km of coastline where the green and blue waves of the Indian Ocean and the Mozambique Channel crash in silvery foam. The land of 'mora mora' invites you to take your time and experience the legendary hospitality and warmth of the Malagasy people.
welcome.p1: An unmissable stop on your journey, ideally located midway between northern and southern Madagascar (RN7 route), Lac Hôtel welcomes you in an exceptional natural setting. Nestled on the shores of Lake Sahambavy at the foot of verdant hills, it offers breathtaking views of the island's only tea plantation, stretching over 520 hectares.
welcome.p2: Stay in charming traditional overwater bungalows, set amid a lush tropical garden where comfort and authenticity come together. Lac Hôtel captivates with its peaceful atmosphere, the beauty of its outdoor spaces, and the quality of its attentive, personalised service.
welcome.p3: An ideal starting point for exploring the surrounding treasures, the hotel also invites you to discover the traditions of Betsileo culture.

ourHouse.label: Our house
ourHouse.title: A family story, turned into a place of welcome
ourHouse.paragraph: In 1998, Kim and Olga Leong bought a plot of land at the edge of Lake Sahambavy to build a simple retirement cabin. Slowly, Olga turned it into a garden of Eden. Train travellers, intrigued, would stop by thinking they'd found a staging post — and so the idea of a hotel was born. Twenty-eight years on, their daughter Maggie has returned from Canada with her husband Sergi; together they have grown the estate into what it is today: some fifty bungalows tucked into unspoiled nature, and a team of more than fifty villagers for whom every guest is a neighbour.
ourHouse.quote: “And the little story isn't over yet.”

loisirs.aventureP: Set off for a full day of immersion in the heart of Betsileo country. This traditional pirogue ride on the Matsiatra River, Madagascar's third-largest river, lets you discover daily village life and the history of the ancient kingdoms.

2-hour pirogue descent between terraced rice paddies, granite mountains and traditional houses

hotel.heroSubtitle: Charm and comfort in the heart of nature
hotel.historyTitle: A dream born by the lake
hotel.historyP1: It was chance that one day led Kim and Olga to the shores of Lake Sahambavy in 1998. Their plan was simple: to buy a piece of land by the lake and build a modest cabin for a peaceful retirement. But under Olga's impetus, the place quickly became a true Garden of Eden.
hotel.historyP2: Over time, travellers on the train stopping at Sahambavy would pause, intrigued by the beauty of the place, thinking they had found a guesthouse… And so the idea was born to open the doors of this little paradise and turn it into a hotel.
hotel.historyP3: Fate then brought the generations together when their eldest daughter, Maggie Leong, returned from Canada with her husband Sergi Formentin to take over the family adventure. The combination of youth and experience transformed this place into a green paradise.
hotel.historyP4: Day after day, the story of Lac Hôtel continues to be written. In nearly 28 years, the estate has grown to welcome around fifty bungalows, nestled in the heart of pristine nature. And the adventure is far from over…
hotel.philosophyP1: At Lac Hôtel, we are actively committed to promoting rural economic development by supporting local labour and the agricultural wealth of Sahambavy village.
hotel.philosophyP2: In a genuine and responsible approach, we produce much of what we offer ourselves: dairy products (cheeses, yoghurts), honey, bread, homemade jams, as well as fruit and vegetables grown on-site, particularly in our orange groves. All our products are organic and from our own production.
hotel.ecoP1: Lac Hôtel is fully committed to corporate social responsibility (CSR) and sustainable development. It actively contributes to the resilience of the local community by prioritising local recruitment, including for management positions.

plantation.historyTitle: From Chinese legend to the hills of Sahambavy
plantation.historyIntro: If tea is a legendary drink, then its story must begin with a legend. In 2737 BC, leaves from a Camellia sinensis shrub accidentally fell into a cauldron of boiling water belonging to Chinese emperor and herbalist Shen Nong. Impressed by the resulting infusion, he quickly adopted this new beverage, which became an essential part of Chinese culture.
plantation.historyMadagascar: Tea arrived in Madagascar through the French colonial period. From the early 20th century, colonial authorities introduced tea cultivation in the Malagasy Highlands. Tea plants were imported from Asia and acclimatised in regions with favourable climates, such as Sahambavy. The name means 'women's fields' in Malagasy, highlighting the key role of women in hand-picking.

historyTimeline.text: First legendary infusion in China by Emperor Shen Nong.
Introduction of tea to Madagascar by French colonial authorities.
Arrival of the French Institute of Coffee and Cocoa — scientific research begins.
The European Development Fund finances the plantation's expansion.
The company becomes a state enterprise under the name SOTEMAD.
Return to the private sector — Mauritian investors. Current name: SIDEXAM Sahambavy.
520 hectares — Madagascar's only tea plantation. Green tea development and organic tea project.

train.introP1: The FCE train (Fianarantsoa–East Coast) is the last passenger train still in service in Madagascar. This mythical line connects Fianarantsoa to Manakara, crossing 162 km of tropical forests, vertiginous cliffs and remote villages accessible only by rail.
train.introP2: Lac Hôtel Sahambavy is located just 2 minutes' walk from Sahambavy station — the ideal starting point for this unique railway adventure.

conditions.heroSubtitle: Rights and commitments — travellers from the European Union
conditions.intro: These conditions govern any booking request made on lachotel.com. They comply with the legal framework applicable to travellers from the European Union (Directive 2011/83/EU and Regulation 524/2013). By submitting the booking form, you acknowledge having read them.

sections.title: 1 · Booking and payment
items: Any booking request becomes a confirmed reservation after receipt of a confirmation email sent by the hotel within 24 hours.
No payment is collected online. Settlement is made on arrival in cash (Ariary or Euros), by credit card, or by prior bank transfer.
Rates displayed on lachotel.com are in Euros (EUR) and per room, taxes included. Promotional offers (e.g. 2-night offer –50 %) cannot be combined with other discounts.
The tourist tax, collected on behalf of the Malagasy State, is added to the rate (approximately 5,000 AR per person per night).
The online form is limited to 20 guests and 4 rooms. For larger groups (seminars, weddings), please contact us directly.

sections.title: 2 · Cancellation and modification
sections.intro: Any cancellation or modification must be communicated by email to booking@lachotel.com. Fees are calculated on the total amount of the initial reservation.
items: More than 60 days before arrival: free cancellation.
From 60 to 15 days before arrival: 20 % of the total amount charged.
From 15 to 5 days before arrival: 70 % of the total amount charged.
Less than 3 days before arrival: 100 % of the total amount charged.
No-show or early departure: 100 % of the total amount charged.
Any date modification is subject to availability and may result in a rate adjustment depending on the season.
In case of documented force majeure (health crisis, natural disaster, official travel restrictions), the hotel commits to offering a fee-free rebooking over an equivalent period within 12 months.

sections.title: 3 · Right of withdrawal
items: In accordance with Article 16(l) of European Directive 2011/83/EU, transposed into Article L221-28 12° of the French Consumer Code, accommodation services provided on a specific date or period do not benefit from the 14-day withdrawal period usually applicable to distance contracts.
Your booking is therefore immediately binding once confirmed by the hotel, subject to the cancellation policy (section 2).

sections.title: 4 · Mediation and dispute resolution
sections.intro: Any dispute relating to the performance of the accommodation contract may be resolved amicably. Failing an amicable agreement, you have the following options:
items: European Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform of the European Commission, open to any consumer residing in the EU: ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/
Tourism and Travel Mediator (MTV) for travellers residing in France: www.mtv.travel
The courts of Madagascar (Fianarantsoa courts) have jurisdiction for any other legal action.

sections.title: 5 · Personal data protection (GDPR)
sections.intro: Data collected via the booking form (name, email, phone, nationality, stay dates) is processed under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, EU Regulation 2016/679):
items: Data controller: Lac Hôtel Sahambavy — Sahambavy, Haute-Matsiatra, Madagascar — booking@lachotel.com
Purpose: processing your booking request, sending confirmations and invoicing.
Legal basis: performance of the accommodation contract (GDPR Art. 6.1.b) and legal obligations (accounting, hotel register).
Recipients: hotel reception and administration team only. No transmission to third parties for commercial purposes.
Retention: 3 years after your stay for customer relations, 10 years for accounting records (legal obligation).
Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection. To exercise these rights: booking@lachotel.com
Supervisory authority: CNIL (France, www.cnil.fr) or any equivalent European authority in your country of residence.
